description: This file contains unit tests for protocol operations related to version 003 in the SNJS project. It tests key generation, encryption/decryption, and other cryptographic functions using the Mocha testing framework and the Chai assertion library.

classes.name: EncryptedPayload
classes.description: A class representing encrypted payload structure used in decryption tests.

classes.name: SNProtocolOperator003
classes.description: Class responsible for cryptographic operations specific to protocol version 003.

classes.name: SNWebCrypto
classes.description: Crypto utility class used for cryptographic functions like generating random keys.

methods.name: createRootKey
methods.description: Creates a root key for a given identifier and password, used for registration.

methods.name: computeRootKey
methods.description: Computes the root key based on password and key parameters, used for sign-in.

methods.description: Decrypts an encrypted payload using the provided key.
